summary: ACDE #236 确认 bal-devnet-7 下周上线，是 Glamsterdam 最后一个计划中的执行层 devnet，并把 EIP-8252（执行层重组状态保留窗口）与 EIP-8254（限制每块存款请求）列为提议纳入，EIP-8246 列为考虑纳入。nerolation 提议把 EIP-8131、EIP-8146 与 EIP-8250 纳入 Hegotá。pochenai 提交 EIP-8130 的四项关键授权与重放修复。

items.title: Ethereal news #22
items.note: 会议内容引自 Ethereal news #22：bal-devnet-7 计划下周上线，是最后一个计划中的执行层 devnet；glamsterdam-devnet-3 已上线；提议纳入 EIP-8252（执行层重组状态保留窗口）与 EIP-8254（限制每块存款请求），考虑纳入 EIP-8246（移除 SELFDESTRUCT 销毁）；Hegotá 非头号提案中提议纳入 EIP-7709（从存储读取 BLOCKHASH 并更新成本）与 EIP-8253（移除 pre-Spurious-Dragon 账户）。
items.note_en: Call notes are from Ethereal news #22: bal-devnet-7 targets next week as the last planned EL devnet; glamsterdam-devnet-3 launched; EIP-8252 (EL reorg state retention window) and EIP-8254 (cap deposit requests per block) were proposed for inclusion and EIP-8246 (remove SELFDESTRUCT burn) considered for inclusion; for Hegotá, non headliners EIP-7709 (read BLOCKHASH from storage and update cost) and EIP-8253 (remove pre-Spurious-Dragon accounts) were proposed.

items.title: EIP-8130：修复四个关键授权与重放问题
items.note: （pochenai）提交：例如把隐式 EOA 授权规则限定在原生 secp256k1 路径，否则通用验证器只要返回 from 地址就能为几乎所有未写入配置的 EOA 满足隐式授权。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: fix four critical authorization and replay issues
items.note_en: (pochenai), submitted: for example limiting the implicit EOA authorization rule to the native secp256k1 path, since otherwise a generic verifier returning the from address could satisfy implicit authorization for almost every EOA without a written config.

Trail of Bits forges Google's quantum cryptanalysis ZK proof
summary_en: ACDE #236 confirmed bal-devnet-7 for next week as Glamsterdam's last planned EL devnet, proposed EIP-8252 (EL reorg state retention window) and EIP-8254 (cap deposit requests per block) for inclusion, and moved EIP-8246 to considered for inclusion. nerolation proposed EIP-8131, EIP-8146 and EIP-8250 for Hegotá. pochenai submitted four critical authorization and replay fixes for EIP-8130.
